items.title: Oracle (ORCL) Could Be 23% Undervalued On Its Cloud And AI Narrative
items.summary: Oracle (ORCL) is back in focus after Oracle Health rolled out new Clinical AI Agent features in the U.S., extending automation across documentation, coding, and chart review workflows inside electronic health records. Despite the new Oracle Health AI features and large cloud and AI contracts, Oracle’s share price is still down 23.81% year to date and the 1 year total shareholder return is down 33.30%. items.title: Why Is Oracle Stock Down Today?
items.summary: Oracle spent $23.7 billion more cash than it brought in last fiscal year and borrowed $43 billion to cover the gap. That's a fine trade when money is cheap. It's a worse one with the 30-year Treasury yield near a 20-year high and long bonds selling off from Tokyo to London.
